answers.question: Is this a net-metered (solar) connection or a standard connection? How did you tell?
answers.answer: This is a standard (not net-metered) connection. The bill shows 2 import registers (Off Peak, Peak) under the regular tariff A1-R, with no export units, no export reading and no net-metering credit.

answers.question: How much fuel adjustment am I being charged (shown as FPA or FCA on the bill), and for which month?
answers.answer: You are charged Rs 290.39 as FCA (fuel charges adjustment). It relates to Feb 2026.

answers.question: If I don't pay on time, what late payment surcharges will be added?
answers.answer: If you pay late (due date 20 Apr 2026), the surcharge is Rs 724.07 until 23 Apr 2026 (total Rs 18,022); then Rs 1,448.13 after 23 Apr 2026 (total Rs 18,745).

answers.question: Am I consuming more units than in the same month last year?
answers.answer: Yes. You used 286 units this month versus 214 units in Apr 2025: 72 more units (+33.6%).

answers.question: What are my average monthly units consumed, and how does this month compare?
answers.answer: Your average over the previous 12 months (Apr 2025 – Mar 2026) is 255.2 units per month. This month's 286 units is 30.8 units (12.1%) above average.

answers.question: How many more units do I consume in summer (June-August) than in winter (December-February)?
answers.answer: You use 393 more units in summer than in winter (1.7× winter). Summer (Jun 2025 – Aug 2025): 993 units, 331 per month. Winter (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026): 600 units, 200 per month. That is 131 units per month more in summer.

answers.question: Looking at the payments for the 12 months shown on the bill, have I been paying every bill?
answers.answer: Yes. Every bill in the 3 months shown (Jan 2026 – Mar 2026) was paid in full.

answers.question: Have my units consumed gone up or down over the last 3 months?
answers.answer: Mixed, up overall. Units went 204 (Feb 2026) → 185 (Mar 2026) → 286 (Apr 2026): +82 units (+40.2%) across the 3 months.

answers.question: Based on the 12 months trend, how many units should I expect to consume next month?
answers.answer: About 341 units in May 2026. Method: May 2025 used 255 units, and this month is +33.6% versus the same month last year (286 vs 214), so 255 × 1.336 ≈ 341.

answers.question: If I wanted to spread my electricity cost evenly across the year, how much should I set aside each month?
answers.answer: Set aside about Rs 15,857 per month. Your electricity cost over May 2025 – Apr 2026 comes to about Rs 190,280 (4 months use the billed amounts printed on the bill and 8 months are estimated from their units at this bill's average of Rs 60.48 per unit), divided by 12 months.

answers.question: If I consume the same units as last month, what would my bill be roughly?
answers.answer: Roughly Rs 12,142 for 185 units (the same as Mar 2026). This scales this month's charges and taxes (Rs 17,296.50 for 286 units) by units used, keeping the fixed charge of Rs 2,700; a different tariff slab or fuel adjustment can change it.
